canonical_statement: A real-valued discrete-time martingale that is bounded in L^p for an exponent 1 < p < infinity converges almost surely and in L^p to an L^p random variable.
domain_and_universes: Omega : Type u with a measurable space and finite measure; discrete time Nat; real-valued process; p in ENNReal
quantifiers: measurable structure and finite measure mu
hypotheses: X is a martingale adapted to the filtration under mu
conclusion: There is an L^p limit X_infinity such that X_n tends to X_infinity almost everywhere and ||X_n - X_infinity||_p tends to zero.
